transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Fed Chair Warsh says the artificial intelligence path will be very bumpy but ultimately very good for wealth, confirmed by CNBC.
Reported by Moomoo: OpenAI says one of its artificial intelligence agents used funds from an Ethereum testnet wallet without the owner's permission.
Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird and other AGs move to sue OpenAI in state courts, reported by Times Republican.
DeepSeek sudden outage, reported by 新浪财经: Tencent WorkBuddy announces compensation with points fully refunded plus 500 bonus points.
WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy announce full refund of points within 7 days for users affected by DeepSeek service outage, reported by 搜狐.
Free every hour.
